ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this debt
ALREADY_PAID: This debt is already fully paid
CANCELLED: This debt was cancelled and cannot receive payments
AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: Amount is more than what is still owed (remaining: {remaining})
AMOUNT_INVALID: Invalid amount. It must be a positive number with at most 2 decimal places
HAS_PAYMENTS: This debt already has collected payments and cannot be changed
NOT_REVERSIBLE: A reversal cannot itself be reversed. Record a new payment instead
PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND: Payment not found on this debt
